topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a folded piece of paper tucked away in a drawer, a list of things my partner wants to do before they're gone. It's a mix of big dreams and small, quiet hopes—seeing the Northern Lights, learning to dance, writing a book. I trace the edges of the paper, each item a whisper of plans we might have missed talking about. The handwriting is familiar, yet the dreams feel distant, like echoes in an empty hall. I wonder if these are the moments they yearn for, moments they imagine without me. I tuck the paper back, smoothing out the creases, hoping the day comes when we can make these dreams, big and small, a part of our story.
